skill.summary: YouTube Data API v3 analytics toolkit. Analyze YouTube channels, videos, and search results. Use when the user asks to: check YouTube channel stats, analyze video performance, compare channels, search for videos, get subscriber counts, view engagement metrics, find trending videos, get channel uploads, or analyze YouTube competition. Requires a YouTube Data API v3 key from Google Cloud Console.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release — YouTube Data API v3 toolkit for channel analytics, video analysis, and search
